name: zero-agency-os

scripts.build: vite build --configLoader runner && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/main/main.js && esbuild src/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/main/preload.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run fetch:node -- --platform darwin --arch arm64 && npm run fetch:node -- --platform darwin --arch x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run fetch:node -- --platform darwin --arch arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run fetch:node -- --platform darwin --arch x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run fetch:node -- --platform win32 --arch x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run fetch:node -- --platform linux --arch x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never

linux.synopsis: A local-first desktop operating layer for human-governed agent teams.
linux.description: A local-first desktop operating layer for human-governed agent teams.
